operational_record.historic_feat: Direct observation of water frost forming on Martian rocks and surface soil during northern hemisphere winter

science_instruments: Surface Seismometer (mounted on top of lander deck)

historic_discoveries.finding: During Sol 891 to 1000, cameras photographed a thin coating of sparkling white water frost persisting for over 200 sols; confirmed seasonal water vapor exchange between atmosphere and surface regolith
historic_discoveries.status: Verified first direct visual proof of modern Martian surface frost

historic_discoveries.finding: Polygon crack patterned ground surrounding the lander suggested permafrost freeze-thaw cycles; later confirmed by MRO SHARAD radar revealing a water ice deposit as large as Lake Superior (375,000 km2) buried 1-10 meters deep
historic_discoveries.status: Primary candidate site for human base water extraction

astronaut_tactical_note: Utopia Planitia is a premier high-latitude resource site. Subsurface pure water ice is accessible within 2-5 meters of excavation. High rock density on surface requires reinforced rover suspension and landing guidance.
